description: Changes a thought's properties: title, caption, aliases, type, colours. Call it to rename or reclassify. It does not touch the note — use brain_set_note or brain_append_note for that.

addAliases.description: Alternate names to add to the ones the thought has; TheBrain's search matches them too. Saving a brain's first alias makes that brain require TheBrain 15.0.621 or later on every device, so write aliases only when the user wants them in this brain.

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

foregroundColor.description: Text colour, for example #ff7145; null clears it.

removeAliases.description: Aliases to drop, matched ignoring case.

typeId.description: Type identifier from brain_list_types_and_tags; null removes the type.

name: brain_update_thought
